annotations.title: Forget a note about the person

description: Forget a note about the person. Delete one of the notes Job Spotter keeps about the person, when they say it is wrong. The note is removed for good; they can add a corrected one with note_about_me. Only for a clear request from the person. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.
name: delete_note
title: Forget a note about the person
